purpose: Challenge Campaign052 against every frozen semantic family before candidate, comparison, daily-price, or return values are read.

selected_mechanism.name: quarterly_announcement_delay_consistency_4q
selected_mechanism.economic_hypothesis: Stable reporting delays across a complete four-quarter cycle indicate a repeatable disclosure process and lower near-term information-timing uncertainty, potentially leaving a more resilient close-known state for the next-open-to-third-close horizon.
selected_mechanism.formula: For the latest four distinct effective reports whose report dates are four consecutive calendar quarter ends, let d_j be the nonnegative integer calendar days from report_date_j to announcement_date_j. Let sigma be the population standard deviation of the four d_j values. Return 1/(1+sigma).
selected_mechanism.consecutive_quarter_rule: exact Q-DEC quarter-end sequence of length four
selected_mechanism.availability_rule: announcement_date must be strictly before the accepted stock-day
selected_mechanism.dispersion_estimator: population standard deviation over exactly four values

overlap_challenges.reason: Freshness is a time-varying accepted-session age since only the latest effective announcement. Campaign052 is constant between disclosures and measures dispersion of four report-specific fiscal-period delays.

Timeliness is the negative delay of the latest report only. Campaign052 discards the four-delay location and retains only their population dispersion, so identical latest delays can have different consistency scores and vice versa.
Campaign052 reads no ROE, profit, revenue growth, profit growth, balance-sheet, valuation, ownership, or accounting amount.
Only stock-day identity and quarterly report/announcement dates are read; no minute price, range, volume, amount, market benchmark, or transaction-price value enters the formula.
The score is computed directly from four source disclosure dates. It does not load either terminal factor value or any fitted or fixed-weight combination of them.
Exactly four consecutive quarters, calendar-day delays, population standard deviation, 1/(1+sigma), and higher direction are fixed once. No alternative is evaluated.

decision.next_action: freeze a fingerprint-bound ordered no-return protocol before candidate values
